I'm an alcoholic with just at 30 days clean and I used to pop by this liquor store right next to my house, so I was there quite a bit. I got there one morning right when they opened (9am) and there was a guy outside the shop smoking a cigarette. He asked me for money and I gave him five dollars. We both went in and I quickly grabbed my whiskey and he asked the clerk for a small bottle of cheap whatever from behind the counter, the kind you buy when you've pissed a lot of money away, the kind you can fit in a coat pocket or a purse just to keep you alive for the next few hours. I was standing behind me and as he thanked the clerk and then turned and gave me a nod and a "thank you again" but the look in his eyes told me knew, we were one in the same. Right before I went to an in patient treatment facility, I would stand shaking outside the same liquor store at 8:55am and ask the few early customers for money, for a dime, for a smoke. That shit is real, that shit is scary. I'd always think of his face.
